name: The Minish Cap Showcase Pack (Test Mod — Link & Zelda)
author: HyruleChosenOne
tagline: Test & showcase mod demonstrating PokéBonk Unbound modding capabilities: custom fighters, movesets, VFX, SFX/cries, Wardrobe skins, and 3D stages.
description: Note: This is a test/showcase mod built to demonstrate PokéBonk Unbound's modding capabilities rather than a polished standalone release. It showcases custom playable characters (Young Link with OOT cries & Princess Zelda with Wind Waker HD voice SFX, both unlocked by default), 6 Wardrobe skins each, dedicated exclusive movesets for both characters (9 Minish Cap sword/item moves for Link + 9 custom Triforce & Goddess magic moves for Zelda, zero vanilla PokéBonk moves), Light Arrows Signature Fusion, custom Ultimates, and 2 unlocked 3D stages (Hyrule Castle & Pyramid of Power) with looping ALttP SNES OSTs.
highlights: Test/showcase mod demonstrating custom characters, movesets, VFX, SFX, Wardrobe skins, fusions, and 3D landmarks
Playable Young Link (#2010, OOT 3D cries) & Princess Zelda (#2024, Wind Waker HD voice SFX) — both unlocked by default
Separate exclusive movesets: 9 Minish Cap Sword/Item moves for Link + 9 Goddess & Triforce Magic moves for Zelda (zero vanilla moves)
6 Wardrobe skins each + Light Arrows Fusion + 3D Hyrule Castle & Pyramid of Power stages with looping ALttP OSTs

changes: Moved showcase test mod into the Experimental tab in the Mod Browser.
Fixed localization helper and GPU VFX table hook compatibility on PokéBonk v0.10.36.
Added playable Princess Zelda (#2024) with Wind Waker HD voice SFX, 9 Goddess & Triforce Magic moves, Light Arrows Fusion, and 6 Wardrobe skins.
Added Hyrule Castle and Pyramid of Power 3D stages with looping ALttP SNES OSTs.

preservedVersions.note: Preserved release for PokéBonk Unbound v1.0.5 (Offline PokéBonk v0.10.31).
